missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Крест' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'висит'. 'Старый' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'на стене' is the prepositional location.

Strategic focus: Accusative inanimate object. 'Крест' is the accusative direct object of 'носит'; as an inanimate masculine noun its accusative matches the nominative. 'Маленький' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Креста' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express that there is none. 'В доме' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Кресту' is in the dative case after 'к' to show movement toward. 'Подошла' agrees in the feminine past.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Крестом' is in the instrumental case, the tool of the action. 'Круг' is the accusative object, and 'рисует' is the present-tense verb.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На кресте' uses the prepositional form 'кресте' after 'на' to mark where the light shines. 'Свет' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Кресты' is the nominative plural subject of 'стоят'. 'Большие' agrees in the plural, and 'в церкви' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Крестов' is genitive plural after 'много'. 'Видим' is the present-tense verb, and 'мы' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Креста' is genitive modifying 'форма' to mean the shape of the cross. 'Простая' is the feminine adjective describing the shape.

Strategic focus: Accusative of placement. 'Крест' is the accusative object of 'повесил', identical to nominative as an inanimate masculine noun. 'Над дверью' is the instrumental location above the door.
